newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IPC Corporation in first rights issue.
newsitem.headline: IPC Corporation in first rights issue.

text.p: Singapore mainboard comapny IPC Corporation Ltd would propose up to 220,418,800 rights shares at S$0.3 each, a company statement said on Monday.
The issue would be priced at S$0.30 for each rights share, on the basis of one rights share for every five ordinary shares of S$0.05 each, the statement said.
The United Overseas Bank Limited has been appointed to manage and underwrite the issue, which is subject to approvals from shareholders, it added.
"The rights issue is the first time IPC Corporation has made a cash call," IPC Chairman and CEO Patrick Ngiam said in the statement.
"This is in line with our group policy of adopting a more moderate borrowing position on minimum debt," Ngiam said.
IPC would use the funds raised from the rights issue as working capital to fuel growth in its telecommunications, computers and peripherals, he said.
